variant: Temporal conflicts among trips, drivers, and vehicles

domain_invariants.requirement: Vehicle ids, driver ids, and trip ids are positive immutable integers; a non-positive id is treated as not found.
A driver has a unique employee_code matching ^[A-Z0-9-]{3,20}$, a full_name of 3..120 characters, and an active flag.

A trip references exactly one existing active driver and one existing active vehicle, has purpose length 3..250, and has planned_end strictly later than planned_start; timestamps are UTC ISO-8601 with second precision.
A vehicle cannot be assigned to overlapping trips in PLANNED or IN_PROGRESS status; intervals sharing an endpoint without overlap are permitted.
A driver cannot be assigned to overlapping trips in PLANNED or IN_PROGRESS status; intervals sharing an endpoint without overlap are permitted.
Trips transition only from PLANNED to IN_PROGRESS or CANCELLED, and from IN_PROGRESS to COMPLETED or CANCELLED; COMPLETED and CANCELLED are terminal.
A trip may start only at or after planned_start and may complete only at or after actual_start. Actual completion is not later than planned_end plus 24 hours.

Vehicle status must be AVAILABLE or ASSIGNED for an active trip: starting a trip atomically changes AVAILABLE to ASSIGNED, and completing or cancelling its last active trip atomically changes ASSIGNED to AVAILABLE.
Cancelled trips retain their driver, vehicle, planning data, cancellation timestamp, and cancellation reason of 3..500 characters as immutable history.
A user may create, read, update, start, complete, or cancel only trips where that user is the requester; admins may operate all trips. Driver records and vehicles are admin-managed.

seed_data: Roles are user and admin. Private endpoints deny by default and require a valid non-expired server-side Bearer session token.
Lists use stable ascending numeric id order, limit 1..100 default 20, and after_id > 0. Each response contains items and next_after_id, null when exhausted.
A vehicle deletion is prohibited while any trip references it. A driver deletion is prohibited while any trip references that driver.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /health publicly with no input or authorization requirement; it shall return deterministic local service status without persistent effects and shall emit only 200 or 503.

The system shall expose GET /drivers as an admin-only endpoint accepting optional active, employee_code_prefix, limit, and after_id; it shall validate boolean, prefix length 1..20, and pagination, use normalized prefix matching and stable pagination, persist no changes, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 422, or 500.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleListDrivers(request):
    // REQ-fleet-temporal-conflict-v1-012; precondition: persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated admin or RETURN 401/403. VALIDATE query or RETURN 422/400.
    READ filtered drivers where id > after_id, order by id ascending, and build next_after_id.
    RETURN 200. // Transaction none; persistent state unchanged; 429/500/503 only when applicable.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /drivers as an admin-only endpoint accepting JSON employee_code, full_name, and optional active=true; it shall validate REQ-fleet-temporal-conflict-v1-002, atomically create a unique driver, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 403, 409, 415, 422, or 500.

The system shall expose GET /trips as an authenticated endpoint accepting optional driver_id, vehicle_id, status, from, to, limit, and after_id; it shall validate ids, enum, UTC date range, and pagination, restrict users to requester-owned trips while admins view all, persist no changes, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 404, 422, or 500.

FUNCTION handleListTrips(request):
    // REQ-fleet-temporal-conflict-v1-014; precondition: persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated user or admin or RETURN 401. VALIDATE filters or RETURN 422/400.
    IF supplied driver_id or vehicle_id is non-positive or absent THEN RETURN 404. END IF
    READ matching trips after cursor; users require requester_id = caller.id under REQ-fleet-temporal-conflict-v1-010.
    RETURN 200 with stable page. // No transaction or persistent effect.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /trips as an authenticated user or admin endpoint accepting JSON driver_id, vehicle_id, purpose, planned_start, and planned_end; it shall validate REQ-fleet-temporal-conflict-v1-003 through REQ-fleet-temporal-conflict-v1-005, assign the caller as requester, atomically create a PLANNED trip, be non-idempotent, return 201 with Location, and emit only 201, 400, 401, 404, 409, 415, 422, or 500.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleCreateTrip(request):
    // REQ-fleet-temporal-conflict-v1-015; preconditions: JSON and persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated user or admin or RETURN 401. REQUIRE application/json or RETURN 415.
    VALIDATE body or RETURN 422/400; require positive existing active driver and vehicle or RETURN 404/409.
    BEGIN TRANSACTION; lock driver and vehicle active-trip intervals.
    IF driver or vehicle interval overlaps THEN ROLLBACK; RETURN 409. END IF
    CREATE PLANNED trip with requester_id = caller.id; COMMIT; RETURN 201 with Location.
    // Non-idempotent; rollback leaves all trip, driver, and vehicle state unchanged.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /trips/{trip_id} as an authenticated endpoint accepting a positive id; it shall return a trip only to its requester or an admin, make no persistent changes, treat non-positive ids as not found, and emit only 200, 401, 403, 404, or 500.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleGetTrip(request, trip_id):
    // REQ-fleet-temporal-conflict-v1-016; precondition: persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated user or admin or RETURN 401. IF trip_id <= 0 OR absent THEN RETURN 404. END IF
    IF caller is user and caller.id != requester_id THEN RETURN 403. END IF
    RETURN 200 with trip. // Transaction none; postcondition: state unchanged.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose PATCH /trips/{trip_id} as an authenticated endpoint accepting JSON purpose, driver_id, vehicle_id, planned_start, or planned_end; it shall permit only a requester or admin to modify a PLANNED trip, validate REQ-fleet-temporal-conflict-v1-003 through REQ-fleet-temporal-conflict-v1-005, atomically update it, be idempotent for an identical valid payload, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, or 500.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handlePatchTrip(request, trip_id):
    // REQ-fleet-temporal-conflict-v1-017; preconditions: JSON and persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated user or admin or RETURN 401. REQUIRE application/json or RETURN 415.
    IF id <= 0 OR absent THEN RETURN 404. IF user is not requester THEN RETURN 403. IF status != PLANNED THEN RETURN 409.
    VALIDATE resulting trip or RETURN 422/400. BEGIN TRANSACTION; lock affected driver and vehicle schedules.
    IF a conflict exists THEN ROLLBACK; RETURN 409. END IF UPDATE trip; COMMIT; RETURN 200.
    // Identical payload is idempotent; rollback preserves all relations.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /trips/{trip_id}/start as an authenticated endpoint accepting a positive id and JSON actual_start; it shall allow only requester or admin to start a PLANNED trip at or after planned_start when the vehicle is AVAILABLE, atomically set IN_PROGRESS and vehicle ASSIGNED, be non-idempotent, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, or 500.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleStartTrip(request, trip_id):
    // REQ-fleet-temporal-conflict-v1-018; preconditions: JSON and persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated user or admin or RETURN 401; REQUIRE application/json or RETURN 415.
    LOAD trip; RETURN 404 if invalid/absent; RETURN 403 if user is not requester; VALIDATE timestamp or RETURN 422/400.
    BEGIN TRANSACTION; lock trip, vehicle, driver, and schedules.
    IF trip not PLANNED, timestamp before plan, conflicts exist, or vehicle not AVAILABLE THEN ROLLBACK; RETURN 409. END IF
    SET trip IN_PROGRESS and vehicle ASSIGNED; COMMIT; RETURN 200.
    // REQ-fleet-temporal-conflict-v1-004, -005, -007, -008; non-idempotent; rollback preserves relations.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /trips/{trip_id}/complete as an authenticated endpoint accepting a positive id and JSON actual_end; it shall allow only requester or admin to complete an IN_PROGRESS trip satisfying REQ-fleet-temporal-conflict-v1-007, atomically set COMPLETED and return its vehicle to AVAILABLE when no active trip remains, be non-idempotent, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, or 500.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleCompleteTrip(request, trip_id):
    // REQ-fleet-temporal-conflict-v1-019; preconditions: JSON and persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated user or admin or RETURN 401; REQUIRE application/json or RETURN 415.
    AUTHORIZE requester/admin; RETURN 404 or 403 when applicable; VALIDATE actual_end or RETURN 422/400.
    BEGIN TRANSACTION; lock trip, vehicle, and active trips.
    IF trip not IN_PROGRESS OR actual_end violates REQ-fleet-temporal-conflict-v1-007 THEN ROLLBACK; RETURN 409. END IF
    COMPLETE trip; if no active trip remains set vehicle AVAILABLE; COMMIT; RETURN 200.
    // Non-idempotent; errors rollback trip and vehicle changes.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose POST /trips/{trip_id}/cancel as an authenticated endpoint accepting a positive id and JSON cancelled_at plus cancellation_reason of 3..500 characters; it shall allow only requester or admin to cancel PLANNED or IN_PROGRESS trips, atomically retain cancellation history and return the vehicle to AVAILABLE when required, be non-idempotent, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 415, 422, or 500.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleCancelTrip(request, trip_id):
    // REQ-fleet-temporal-conflict-v1-020; preconditions: JSON and persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated user or admin or RETURN 401; REQUIRE application/json or RETURN 415.
    AUTHORIZE requester/admin; RETURN 404 or 403 when applicable; VALIDATE body or RETURN 422/400.
    BEGIN TRANSACTION; lock trip, vehicle, and active trips.
    IF status is terminal THEN ROLLBACK; RETURN 409. END IF
    SET CANCELLED and immutable cancellation fields; if last active trip set vehicle AVAILABLE; COMMIT; RETURN 200.
    // REQ-fleet-temporal-conflict-v1-006, -008, -009; non-idempotent; rollback preserves all relations.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /drivers/{driver_id}/trip-conflicts as an admin-only endpoint accepting a positive driver id, planned_start, planned_end, optional exclude_trip_id, limit, and after_id; it shall validate UTC interval and pagination, return active overlapping trips using the same overlap semantics as REQ-fleet-temporal-conflict-v1-005 without persistent effects, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 422, or 500.

pseudocode.body:
FUNCTION handleDriverTripConflicts(request, driver_id):
    // REQ-fleet-temporal-conflict-v1-021; precondition: persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated admin or RETURN 401/403. IF driver_id <= 0 OR absent THEN RETURN 404.
    VALIDATE interval, optional positive exclude id, and pagination or RETURN 422/400.
    READ PLANNED/IN_PROGRESS trips for driver whose interval overlaps query; exclude requested trip; paginate stably.
    RETURN 200. // Transaction none; postcondition unchanged.

apis.formal_requirement: The system shall expose GET /vehicles/{vehicle_id}/trip-conflicts as an admin-only endpoint accepting a positive vehicle id, planned_start, planned_end, optional exclude_trip_id, limit, and after_id; it shall validate UTC interval and pagination, return active overlapping trips using REQ-fleet-temporal-conflict-v1-004 without persistent effects, and emit only 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 422, or 500.

FUNCTION handleVehicleTripConflicts(request, vehicle_id):
    // REQ-fleet-temporal-conflict-v1-022; precondition: persistence available.
    REQUIRE authenticated admin or RETURN 401/403. IF vehicle_id <= 0 OR absent THEN RETURN 404.
    VALIDATE interval, optional positive exclude id, and pagination or RETURN 422/400.
    READ overlapping PLANNED/IN_PROGRESS vehicle trips, exclude requested trip, and paginate by id.
    RETURN 200. // Transaction none; persistent state remains unchanged.
